system.description:
No longer bound to places she can see, the Daughter of Cacophony projects speech or song to anyone she knows, wherever they may be. So long as night has fallen at the listener's location, her voice reaches across any distance to their ears alone.

Expend one Blood Trait to project your voice for a single turn (retest Performance). The words and music are audible only to your chosen target and cannot be overheard, unless an eavesdropper with at least the Intermediate level of Auspex manages to listen in by defeating you in a Mental Challenge. The power functions only while it is night where your target stands.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
